title: DBT Redshift Unload Macro Failing
answer:
You're attempting to run this as a post-hook command on top of a DBT model. DBT will first run your unload_test model to build a table with the same name and then the post-hook runs after that first step is complete. Your model is empty which is what is causing the failure.

Usually, you would run a post-hook on a model to take action on the table after it's built. In your case, you should be running the post-hook in the stg_payment_transaction model. If you don't have a model for this (or don't have access to it because it's in another project), you can move your post-hook to on-run-end in dbt_project.yml
